notes.title: Kijo Plushie Giveaway
notes.content:
A dangerously adorable Kijo has found her way to our world to be your cutest nightmares' companion!

We are super happy to announce our first merchandise based on Ikai. Thanks to Makeship, we are able to bring Kijo to life in this limited edition plushie.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910353/894fb83db9bf13337ae11ebd675b12443855d665.png

The campaign will launch next week, starting the 21st of June and will last 21 days. Don't want to miss it? Get notified when the campaign launches.

Kijo has always had a special place in our heart. It has been with us since the beginning in our first demo and we think it really represents the spirit of Ikai. 

Makeship did an outstanding job transforming this terrifying yokai into a fluffy little monster looking forward to jump at you for hugs or revenge. 

We hope that you are as thrilled as us to bring it to your home :D

If the campaign is successful and the community has interest, more plushies can come in the future!

GIVEAWAY

Thanks to the partnership with Makeship, you have the chance to win 1 of 2 Kijo Plushies.

How to enter?

[olist]
 Head to Twitter and follow @Makeship, @PMStudiosUSA and @endflamestudio
 Retweet this post
[/olist]

Contest ends June 20th at 6PM (GMT). Good luck!

notes.title: Ikai Patch v1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Just wanted to inform you of the things we improved for this patch:


 Option to disable headbob
 The sticks of the well are easier to identify between the bones
 Fixed an issue where players that played the very first prototype on Itch.io and clicked continue the first time they play the game, resulted in a corrupted save file.
 Minor bugfixing


Thank you so much for your continued support. If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please let us know!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have made some changes to the demo thanks to the feedback of the players in order to improve the experience.

OPTIMIZATION: the game should run much smoother and at a higher frame rate than before. If you are still experiencing low frame rates, consider lowering the shadows quality, this should help considerably.

DRAWING: ok, it was too hard to draw the seal and very difficult with gamepad, sorry ːsteamsadː
Now, it's easier to do it correctly and doesn't require that much precision. Also, the precision needed with gamepad is different than with mouse. It won't require that much precision with gamepad.

MINOR BUGFIXING: that's it, no more bugs.

Thanks to everyone that played the demo and to everyone that gave us feedback to improve the final game. We hope that these fixes address the main issues of the demo and help improving the experience.

If you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please let us know!
